server.source: ServerHello + minisign verification against repo-pinned key

games.note: Choose-one branch: P0 controls Lockjaw + Storm Crow, casts Divination in PreCombatMain. Beginning-of-combat trigger fires; reflexive prompt appears EXACTLY ONCE (TriggerTargetSelection, schema/sequence, candidates=[Storm Crow]); driver answers with the Crow. Trigger resolves; game reaches DeclareAttackers with empty stack; no second prompt (prompt_count=1, reopen_count=0).

Choose-zero branch: same setup; driver answers the single reflexive prompt with an empty selection. Trigger resolves; DeclareAttackers reached with empty stack; no second prompt (prompt_count=1, reopen_count=0).

notes: Parse layer (pinned v0.81.1 card-data.json): Lockjaw's reflexive sub-ability carries multi_target {min: 0, max: Fixed 1}, condition WhenYouDo, duration UntilEndOfTurn -- the 'up to one other target creature you control' structure the report is about.

Runtime layer, game A: the reflexive prompt surfaced once as waiting_for type TriggerTargetSelection (NOT legacy TargetSelection) with a viewer_interaction schema/sequence opportunity; candidate was P0's Storm Crow. After answering, the stack emptied and the game advanced to DeclareAttackers -- the prompt never reopened.
Runtime layer, game B: the same single prompt answered with an empty selection completed the trigger identically -- the decline path works.

Authoritative post-trigger states: Lockjaw carries a +1/+1 counter; CantBeBlocked markers present on Lockjaw in both games and on the chosen Crow in game A. Combat resolved (P1 20->17 both games); both games reached End with an empty stack and no stall.
Zero rejections/errors across both games in the final run; prompt_count=1 and reopen_count=0 per game (wire_log.jsonl).

Verdict rationale: the reported outcome -- the reflexive prompt returning after the choice is made and looping through priority -- did not occur on v0.81.1 in either the choose-one or the choose-zero branch. Every assertion passed.
setup_line: P0 (4x Lockjaw + 8x Storm Crow + 12x Divination + 36x Island) vs P1 (12x Storm Crow + 48x Island); two human-driver seats
contract_line: After casting a noncreature spell, Lockjaw's beginning-of-combat trigger puts a +1/+1 counter on it and its reflexive 'up to one other target creature' prompt fires exactly once; the choice (or empty choice) completes and the game advances without re-prompting

stats.trigger_observations: reflexive TriggerTargetSelection observed once per game in wire_log.jsonl (reflexive_prompt events)

limitations: Native AI seats not used; the trigger/prompt path is engine-level and seat-independent
Dense playsets are a test-harness convenience (engine accepts >4-of for custom games)
The prebuilt server has no standalone state-restore; states are authoritative exports (restorable only via full game replay)
Not tested on the report's original build; verdict is scoped to v0.81.1, not a fix claim
restoration: a_pre.json/a_post_trigger.json/a_post.json and the b_* set are authoritative export envelopes ({"precast_shortcut_runtime", "state"}); restored only by inspection in this run, not re-imported into a live game (no ImportAuthoritativeState path used).
